claims.assertion: Athena speculated that the Cabal sought Russia’s defeat by Ukraine to weaken Russia’s global image and restore Western power.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She framed war-economy benefits as collateral and cited economic motives.

claims.assertion: Athena said the war was controlled theater serving geopolitical agendas, while civilian suffering and deaths remained real.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena forecast that Russia might be declared defeated within days or weeks, but called this an educated opinion rather than a precise prediction.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She said it could change daily and allowed for prolonged war or false-flag escalation.
